issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Make "Click Ten" as a tiny web game played in the browser: one page with a button and a counter; each click adds one, and at ten clicks the game shows "You did it!" and a button to play again, which resets the counter to zero.

One HTML file with its script and style inside it; no images, sound or libraries.

issue.author: playtester
issue.body: I will play each released version in headless Chromium (Playwright): click to ten, check the counter, the 'You did it!' message and the play-again reset, and check it is a single HTML file with no images, sound or libraries. I will report one issue per problem, with the version played and screenshots. Nothing can be played until a version is released in world/result.
issue.title: Playtest commitment: Click Ten

comments.author: playtester
comments.body: Played release v1 (delivery-v1.tar.gz, index.html) in headless Chromium via Playwright. Start shows counter 0; each click adds one to 10; at 10 'You did it!' and 'Play again' appear and the click button hides; Play again resets to 0 and restores the game. No page errors; single HTML file with no external references, images, sound or libraries. No problems found.
